shape.description: Glyph shape rendered for each data point.

size.description: Default glyph area in square pixels.

strokeWidth.description: Outline stroke width for hollow glyphs.

opacity.description: Default opacity applied to each point for overplotting.

renderIntent.description: JSON-encoded Cartesian viz.render input fragment for the governed authoring recipes. Data rows remain a consumer operand.

previewSvg.description: Static SVG returned by viz.render for the authored sample; omitted until a chart is rendered.

chart.title: MarkPointChartDeclaration
chart.description: Read-only chart rendered by public viz.render during code generation. Payment events retain the Subscription projection. Record-array charts bind a declared object array and use authored sampleRows to seed generated sample records, with no separate generated chart series. Edge-array charts bind a declared neighborhood array: sorted distinct node ids, row-ordered directed links, optional bidirectional reverse links deduplicated by ordered pair, without numeric values or groups. Static SVG assets are keyed by seed record identity; consumers can replace the typed svg prop. One distinct chart declaration is supported per generated object; repeated identical projections share the same asset.

dataField.description: Declared objectSchema array field containing the chart rows.

encodings.description: Channel -> field bindings. Required, with at least x and y, when chartType is supplied (explicit mode).

sampleRows.description: Authored sample rows, including explicitly labelled synthetic examples, copied into the declared array field of generated sample records. These exact records supply public viz.render; no separate synthetic chart series is invented.

minorUnits.description: Money (s223-m01), declared with currencyField: the y encoding's field holds amounts in minor units. Generation divides each row's value by minorUnits, as the payment-events source does, and formats the y axis in the record's currency ("$,f": $12,000 for USD, £12,000 for GBP).

currencyField.description: Money (s223-m01), declared with minorUnits: the charted record's field holding its ISO 4217 currency code (Invoice's currency). Its symbol prints on the y axis and the code in the chart's accessible description.

title.description: Title of the read-only chart projection.

description.description: Accessible description of the read-only chart projection.

chartEncodingBinding.title: MarkPointChartEncodingBinding
chartEncodingBinding.description: An encoding binding: either a bare field-name string, or an object with the field plus optional aggregate/scale/timeUnit/sort/title.

type.description: Force the Vega-Lite/ECharts field type, overriding the engine's data-aware inference (sprint-125 m02 manual escape hatch). Wins over the m01 profile-derived type.

format.description: Label format of this channel's axis (x, y) or legend: a d3-format specifier such as "$,f" or ",.0f" (d3-time-format for a temporal field). "$" prints the currency symbol: the currency's, else $. Without a precision, labels take the precision of the tick step, so neighbouring ticks never print the same text. Carried in the normalized spec, so artifact.certify replays it.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the amounts this channel encodes, for example EUR. The labels print its en-US symbol where the format has "$" (EUR €, GBP £); without a format they read "$,f" ($12,000). One currency per chart. A record-array declaration's money (minorUnits and currencyField) sets it from each record.

titleField.description: Declared charts only: a field of the charted record whose text titles this axis, so each record's chart names its own unit (Usage's y axis reads the record's unit_label, "API calls"). Generation resolves it into title before viz.render; a record without that text takes title, and a chart with neither fails.

chartColorEncodingBinding.title: MarkPointChartColorEncodingBinding
chartColorEncodingBinding.description: A color-channel encoding binding: like encodingBinding, plus an optional explicit `range` (hex colors) that overrides the baked OODS categorical palette on a nominal/ordinal color scale (sprint-147 F5). `range` is only valid on the color channel.

type.description: Force the Vega-Lite/ECharts field type, overriding the engine's data-aware inference (sprint-125 m02 manual escape hatch). Wins over the m01 profile-derived type.

range.description: Explicit hex colors for a nominal/ordinal color scale (sprint-147 F5). Overrides the baked OODS categorical palette so an agent can supply its own scale (e.g. a 2-color presence scale). Applied in array order to the distinct series; a shorter range recycles (Vega domain[i]->range[i] mod len). Cartesian color only.
